items.item_text: Bachelor's degree in related area and/or equivalent experience/training.
Advanced degree in related field.
6 - 10 years of related experience.
Previous supervisory experience.
Experience managing employee and/or labor relations issues.
Experience providing strategic human resources leadership within a higher education environment.
Experience with the University of California Riverside policies, procedures, and processes.

Consults with senior managers on complex collective bargaining agreements and any additional policies and procedures. Supports labor negotiations, prepares data and provides complex analysis, assists in resolving grievances and drafting counseling or corrective actions per policy. (25% time)
As technical leader, provides guidance to managers and senior leaders on compensation programs. (15% time)

Develops, implements, and maintains standard operating procedures governing departmental human resources programs, processes, operations, and workflow management. Collaborates with the broader ASSET Human Resources team, as appropriate, to assess and enhance organizational processes, ensuring consistency, operational efficiency, compliance, and standardization across units. Coordinates closely with Central Human Resources and other campus stakeholders to support the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of organizational HR programs, policies, and business processes that advance institutional objectives and workforce effectiveness. (15% time)
Provides guidance on full-cycle recruitment including job postings, applicant review, interviewing, selection and hiring for leadership positions. (10% time)

Provides guidance to senior managers in resolving complex performance and workforce issues. Recommends changes to current practices and contributes to performance management framework. Works on complex department reorganizations and staffing initiatives to meet business objectives. (10% time)

Provides direct supervision, leadership, training, and ongoing support to assigned staff regarding human resources policies, procedures, and best practices. Assigns and prioritizes work responsibilities to ensure efficient operations and the timely completion of departmental objectives. In consultation with the Director of Human Resources & Executive Searches, develops work schedules, establishes priorities, and allocates assignments to support operational needs and promote staff development and effectiveness. (10% time)

Counsels employees, managers and senior leaders on complex work -related issues. Conducts difficult termination interviews providing feedback to management and recommends improvements to department practices as appropriate. (5% time)

Identifies opportunities and provides strategic guidance to management on professional development initiatives. Designs and / or delivers comprehensive HR training programs tailored to diverse audiences. (5% time)
Conducts advanced analyses to determine appropriate course of action and implications, and advise leadership on complex HR-related issues. (5% time)
Read/Comprehend: Constantly
Write: Constantly
Perform Calculations: Occasionally
Communicate Orally: Constantly
Reason & Analyze: Constantly
Sit: Constantly
Stand: Occasionally
Walk: Occasionally
Demonstrated ability to handle extremely difficult or volatile situations / individuals effectively.

Advanced knowledge of human resources concepts, policies and procedures including employment practices, labor relations, salary administration, training and other areas of human resources as well as organizational initiatives relating to and / or affecting human resources.
Strong analytical, active listening, and critical thinking skills.
Advanced interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills to present complex information.
Possesses advanced analytical skills to conduct analysis and develop recommendations, demonstrating organization and problem-solving skills. Has working knowledge of other areas of HR.
In-depth knowledge of a human resources management system (HRMS), and / or other related business software programs and systems.
Demonstrated advanced knowledge of organizational policies and procedures; advanced knowledge of functional area and understands how work affects other areas in Human Resources and the organization.
Exceptional political acumen with the ability to anticipate organizational impacts, manage sensitive situations, and foster productive stakeholder relationships.
